purpose: Test whether restricting V158 nonterminal short-work speculation to the existing below-8 slack regime retains enough QPR benefit while removing congestion-time capacity reservation.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.v157_observation: Terminal-only pipeline placement passed the throughput gates but left the complete QPR mean 0.0011433623 below OCS.
causal_diagnosis.v158_observation: Unrestricted short-work speculation passed both QPR gates but reduced the throughput paired count from 12/20 to 11/20.
causal_diagnosis.mechanism: A short unfinished request can benefit from speculative container preparation when the cluster has slack, but the same placement reserves HPA-owned capacity under backlog. The already frozen queue-8 operational boundary distinguishes those regimes without adding a new fitted threshold.

frozen_thresholds.queue_density_definition: current pending plus runnable tasks divided by node count
frozen_thresholds.remaining_work_definition: sum over unfinished functions of cpu/mean_node_cpu + cold_start_frames/1000 + output_mb/1000
frozen_thresholds.derivation: 5.5 is inherited unchanged from V158 and 8.0 is inherited unchanged from the V155 router; V159 introduces no new fitted threshold.

single_mechanism_change_from_v158.ready_players: unchanged: admit after every parent completes
single_mechanism_change_from_v158.terminal_pipeline_players: unchanged: admit when every parent has an assigned node at every queue density

single_mechanism_change_from_v158.congested_short_pipeline_players: reject nonterminal short-work players at queue density 8.0 or above
single_mechanism_change_from_v158.over_threshold_pipeline_players: reject nonterminal parents-scheduled players with request remaining work above 5.5
